question: ______ has become the first city in the country to get a processed steel slag (industrial waste) road.
solution:
The correct answer is __Surat.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Surat in Gujarat has become the first city in the country to get a processed steel slag (industrial waste) road.
 
• The first 6-lane highway made using Steel Slag was inaugurated in Surat by Union Steel Minister Ram
